instruction: A tabletop fan in full 1930s deco dress: a chromed sunburst cage of radiating wires fronts four polished aluminum blades, mounted on a stepped ziggurat base of black bakelite with inlaid ivory chevrons. The motor housing is a fluted bullet of brushed nickel banded in gold, and a small lever switch sits on a fan-shaped escutcheon. Every edge is crisp, symmetrical, and mirror-bright.
